sloka: मम प्रियतरो नित्यं भ्राता रामस्य लक्ष्मणः ।नियुक्तो धुरि यस्यां तु तामुद्वहति वीर्यवान् ।। ५.३८.६३।।।।
transliteration: mama priyataro nityaṁ bhrātā rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।niyukto dhuri yasyāṁ tu tāmudvahati vīryavān ।। 5.38.63।।।।

translations.english: "He is Lakshmana for whose care and support Rama did not miss the noble king Dasaratha (during exile). Convey him my words of enquiry about his wellbeing.
